heading: Pick the level of ongoing care that fits your site.
lede: Five plans, from Site Watch to Full Local Presence. Each one includes everything in the plan before it.
trackLabel: Use the left and right arrow keys to move between the five plans.
exclusions: Ecommerce/catalog/checkout changes, redesigns, migrations, custom apps, large integrations, after-hours emergencies and anything requiring its own scope of work are scoped separately. No ranking, traffic, lead or revenue guarantees. You keep ownership of your accounts.

tiers.name: Site Watch
tiers.job: Keep my site healthy and watched
items: Automated health, uptime and security checks
Software and plugin updates where the platform needs them
The easiest safe self-editing path for your platform

tiers.name: Site Care
tiers.job: Handle the tiny changes for me too
items: Small text and photo updates done by LDW each month (non-ecommerce)

tiers.name: Site Care Plus
tiers.job: Manage the site and handle routine changes
items: A view-only GSC Search Performance snapshot with 1–3 prioritized recommendations, only where actually available
Periodic website health and visibility evidence in the report

tiers.name: Local Visibility
tiers.job: Keep improving my site and local visibility
tiers.lead: Everything in Site Care Plus, plus
items: A monthly Visibility Pulse (search, AI and local visibility monitoring)
Bounded remediation of the top 1–3 safe/approved recommendations
Reputation Lite (review management: requests where provider/data boundaries allow, alerts, a review link and QR code, and reporting)

tiers.name: Full Local Presence
tiers.job: Manage the website, visibility and reputation as one system
items: LDW manages the ongoing visibility and reputation loop: broader monitoring and trends, fuller fixes with your approval on bigger changes, human-approved review responses, priority scheduling, richer reporting
